scope: local Arch ARM fixture initramfs rebuild; no M4 hardware boot
change: The M4 initramfs configuration explicitly includes appledrm, asahi_m4 and phy-apple-dptx in addition to storage drivers. The previous default image did not include these display modules. Firmware lookup also accepts the Gravity and Asahi EFI identifiers and rejects conflicting IDs. Btrfs is explicitly included for the Omarchy root layout.
checks: real mkinitcpio built default and fallback images
both images include the M4 display, NVMe and encryption modules
each image contains the modprobe dependency closure for display, NVMe and encryption drivers
boot-check fixtures reject an image without the HDMI PHY
Gravity-only and conflicting EFI identifiers exercised in disposable firmware and boot-check fixtures
both images contain Btrfs and its modular dependency closure; the boot checker rejects its absence
limitations: images use the generic disposable Arch ARM root and are not target-specific
firmware handoff, early console, HDMI and boot remain untested on M4 hardware
